dolomites.overview: The Dolomites offer world-class walking among sheer limestone towers and high alpine pastures. The 75-mile Alta Via 1 is a renowned strenuous trek taking 10 to 13 days, while the Tre Cime di Lavaredo loop provides a moderate day hike with iconic views. The season runs from late June to September when the extensive network of mountain huts and cable cars is fully open.
